---
title: "About Stat Mania"
description: "Stat Mania is a free site of statistics, programming and Linux tutorials, lecture slides, games and small tools."
---


**Stat Mania** is a free site for learning statistics and the computing that goes with it. This blog is one part of it: short tutorials, worked examples and notes, written to be read once and reused later.

## The logo

![The Stat Mania logo: a styled S and M joined by a summation sign and an integral sign.](logo.svg){fig-alt="Stat Mania logo: a styled S and M, with a summation sign and an integral sign." width=180 fig-align="center"}

The logo is built from the initials of **Stat Mania**: a styled **S** and **M**. It also joins two foundations of statistics: the summation sign (∑) for discrete variables and the integral sign (∫) for continuous ones. Together they represent the whole scope of statistics, covering every type of data.

## What we write about

- **Statistics:** descriptive statistics, probability, hypothesis testing, regression and time series, with the intuition before the formulas.
- **Programming:** [R](tags.html#tag=r), [C](tags.html#tag=c) and [Python](tags.html#tag=python), from first programs to practice problems with answers.
- **Linux and tools:** the [command line](tags.html#tag=command-line), Git, Quarto and LaTeX, the tools we use to build lecture material and run analyses.

Browse by [tag](tags.html) or [category](categories.html), or follow the [RSS feed](index.xml).

## How the posts are made

- Code examples are compiled or run before publishing, and the output shown is the real output.
- Tutorials are short and concrete, and each one covers a single idea.
- Every post lists its tags, so related posts are easy to find.

## Use of AI

Drafts on this blog are written with the help of AI tools. Every post is then reviewed, edited and tested by the named author, who takes responsibility for its accuracy. Code is compiled and run before publishing, and the output shown is real.

## The rest of Stat Mania

The [portal](https://www.statmania.info) also has:
